Question: Trapezoid \( ABCD \) has parallel sides \( \overline{AB} \) of length \( 33 \) and \( \overline {CD} \) of length \( 21 .\) The other two sides are of lengths \( 10 \) and \( 14 .\) The angles \( A \) and \( B \) are acute. What is the length of the shorter diagonal of \( ABCD ?\)
